notes.title: Super Island God VR is finally out of early access!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26821134/937c6138e229ea326b354c170f6496cf2e6ce73f.png[/img]

Super Island God VR is finally out of early access! This release adds the final desert biome level - flex your management skills to build your population as quickly as you can, but beware the pirate ghosts! This release also includes a bunch of performance, balance, and quality of life fixes, including a new spell that will let you heal damaged buildings and villagers!

[u]Features:[/u]
[list]
[*] Added the final desert island level.
[*] Added a "Restore" spell that heals buildings and villagers. This spell is available for all levels.
[*] Added health bars to buildings, and changed their behavior so they're always visible until the villager or building are healed.
[*] Builders automatically assign themselves as workers after completing construction.
[*] Added a saw toy to the lumber-yard.
[*] Added a player height adjustment slider to the options.
[*] Added teleport movement mode
[/list]

[u]Bugs & Polish:[/u]
[list]
[*] The "Restart level" option in the pause menu will actually restart the level rather than quit to the main menu.
[*] Optimized frame rate.
[*] Fixed an issue that was preventing saved settings from applying on startup.
[*] Eliminated render artifacts with the water when MSAA was enabled.
[*] Fixed a bug where food consumption was incorrectly tripled in level 5.
[*] Fixed a UI issue that caused missed input with slider bars.
[*] Fixed flickering on the hand options in the main menu.
[*] Adjusted the size of the level islands and other text on the main menu level to make things more readable.
[*] Force spawn a villager to auto-build a dock on the second tier in level 5.
[*] Fixed the medium hut.
[*] Increased volcano eruption delay by 10 seconds.
[*] Volcano eruptions only cause a guaranteed fire for one building.
[*] Improved the responsiveness of the rotate and zoom gestures.
[/list]

notes.title: Super Island God VR version 0.3 released
notes.content:
Hey folks,

We apologize for the delay in pushing this update to the game. We've been struggling with issues on the side that have prevented us from working on the title as much as we'd like. We've now pushed our .3 update up which focuses on bugfixes and some usability tweaks to improve the VR experience.

Super Island God VR 0.3 release notes

- Player movement has been overhauled to reduce motion-sickness and improve responsiveness.

-A teleport-to-move option has been added for players who prefer that locomotion method.

-The player's god-like powers have been expanded to allow them to place resources safely back in the ground after being grabbed. Simply hold a tree or rock close to the ground and release when you see the indicator.

-A small assortment of bugfixes.

notes.title: Early Access Patch - 0.2.0
notes.content:
Patch 0.2.0 Patch Notes: 

Content: 

The Holiday cheer awaits you in this latest update.  Participate in a holiday themed event running from December 15th through January 15th and enjoy the festivities!

Can you solve the Sphinx's secret? A new Desert Biome has been released for players to explore.  Unlock brand new cosmetics and find the secrets in this new desert themed island!

[Experimental] Added an option to enable MSAA.

Bug Fixes:

- Moved to Unreal Engine's Forward Renderer, drastically increasing frame rate. 
- Optimized post process effects to increase frame rate.
- Removed post process effects from in-game text to increase frame rate.

notes.title: Early Access Hotfix - 0.1.6
notes.content:
Hotfix 0.1.6 Patch Notes: 


- Fixed a bug that caused level 3 to not end when losing all of your villagers to starvation
- Hands no longer get stuck in a fist after destroying something in the volcano on level 3
- Adjusted drop off point on the quarry to help prevent villagers from bunching up and getting stuck
- The palette will now force close any time a player enters a menu
- Adjusted collision on push buttons to improve responsiveness
- Scaled gravity off world scale so objects are less floaty when you're zoomed out
- Fixed a common crash resulting from villager AI pathing
